title: AI receptionist v1: WhatsApp (incl. outreach), email replies, website chat

state.product: Zenno Booking (Vite SPA + Supabase eicxhwgxelwcmxcjppwt + Deno edge functions). Wellness/massage shops in Germany, older non-technical owners (DE/EN/TH). Existing: services/prices/therapists, get_available_slots, agent hold->confirm API with merchant consent (auto/manual), gift cards (value + service passes, sets, online purchase page), promotion texts, email marketing with unsubscribe, SMTP sending from the shop's own mailbox (port 465), notification outbox via pg_cron, TypeSafe Jev confidence gating (threshold 0.7).
state.request: Owner wants an AI receptionist acting as a full agent on 1) WhatsApp, including outreach to past customers (only a consented imported list), 2) email replies based on availability, slots, promotions, prices, gift cards, auto-applying things, 3) a website embedded chat bot. AI usage unlimited for now; owner routes the LLM himself (OpenAI-compatible endpoint); credits resold later.
state.existing_receptionist_repo: Separate Next.js app (zenno) with WhatsApp via unofficial Evolution/Baileys QR gateway (own number, no Meta verification, warm-up caps 20->200/day, ban risk, needs an always-on server) and a 360dialog/Cloud API adapter, Telegram/LINE/Messenger, webchat widget, campaigns. Its server code is portable to Deno.
state.whatsapp_facts: Official WhatsApp Cloud API: Meta business verification + phone number, free-form replies only within 24h of the customer's last message, business-initiated outreach only via Meta-approved templates (marketing templates cost per message), no ban risk. QR gateway: any message any time, free, but against WhatsApp terms; bulk outreach from a fresh number risks a ban of the shop's own number.
state.email_facts: Shops already store SMTP credentials of their own mailbox (e.g. Strato info@satuuu99.de). Inbound options: poll the same mailbox via IMAP (port 993, allowed from Supabase edge) with the same credentials, or ask shops to set up forwarding to a Zenno inbound address (needs an inbound email provider account + DNS on our domain, and per-shop forwarding setup at their mail host).
state.constraints: One developer (Claude). Production DB writes need the user's approval in a terminal. Owners are non-technical: setup must be a few clicks. GDPR/UWG: marketing messages need prior consent; Germany.
state.risk: An agent that auto-books and auto-replies can embarrass a shop (wrong price, invented promotion, double booking).

whatsapp_route.instructions: Which WhatsApp connection does v1 ship?

criteria.both_adapters: One WhatsApp channel interface with two connection types the shop picks: official Cloud API (recommended, templates for outreach) and QR 'own number' gateway (opt-in, warm-up caps, outreach throttled, clear ban-risk warning).
criteria.cloud_api_only: Only the official Cloud API; outreach only via approved templates.
criteria.qr_only: Only the QR gateway (own number), outreach as plain messages with warm-up caps.

email_inbound.instructions: How does the agent receive customer emails?

criteria.imap_poll: Poll the shop's existing mailbox via IMAP every minute with the credentials they already entered (one extra field: IMAP server), reply via the existing SMTP sender, mark handled mails as read.
criteria.forward_webhook: Shops forward their mail to a Zenno inbound address handled by an inbound email provider webhook.

autonomy.instructions: How autonomous is the agent at launch?

criteria.auto_with_gate: Replies and books automatically; anything risky (low confidence, complaints, refunds, medical, prices or promotions it cannot find in the data, cancellations inside the cancellation window) goes to a human review queue as a draft and the conversation is flagged. Shop can switch each channel to 'drafts only'.
criteria.drafts_only: Agent only writes drafts; a human sends every message.
criteria.fully_auto: Agent answers everything automatically with no review queue.

build_order.instructions: In which order are the three channels built (one shared agent core first)?

criteria.web_email_whatsapp: Agent core + website chat first (testable today, no external accounts), then email (credentials already exist), then WhatsApp (needs Meta or a gateway server).
criteria.whatsapp_first: WhatsApp first, then email, then website chat.

outreach_consent.instructions: How is consent for outreach handled?

criteria.explicit_consent_record: Outreach only to customers with a stored consent record per channel (source, timestamp, text shown). Imports must contain a consent column; rows without it are imported as contacts but never messaged. Every outreach message carries an opt-out ('STOP'), which is honoured automatically.
criteria.trust_import: Anyone on the imported list may be messaged.
